steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: I am in position.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: As Her Grace's latest instructions state, Ratatos's feigned death must have a reason. She is most likely carrying important information on her person, and is to be captured alive.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: This is the front, the courtyard is empty. Prepare for direct contact.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: Do not attract attention. End it quick.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: The only thing to watch out for is the Black Knight, who is most likely still here.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: But where is she?
The intruder looks about warily, holding his weapon tight.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: Not good!
A black degenbrecher flies at unbelievable speed towards him. The intruder is sent flying by the incredible force, slamming against the walls.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: I heard... more fighting outside. What in the blazes is going on?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Quiet down!

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The trickiest enemies for us to handle are outside right now. Degenbrecher's risking her life to protect us.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: The only thing you can do right now is sit down, shut up and not be discovered.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: I... I heard the broadcast say that I'm a hostage abducted by Kjerag? Why...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Heh... Your fellow Victorians got their weapons out and started up their tanks. They're not letting anything out of this place.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So are they here to rescue you, or are they here to keep people in the know locked up in here so they can get their other plans done? The answer is obvious.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: You mean they're using my rescue as an excuse to invade Kjerag...?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: It's what you said... and it seems reality agrees with you.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: ...How did it all come to this?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If you've got a way to get the information out, you can ask your fellow countrymen that question.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: When I came to this place, I thought I could help the oppressed people. With my camera and my words, I would be able to let more people know about the true Kjerag.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: I believed all that I did had meaning...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: ...Should I be thanking you for your kindness or something?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Alright, alright, I'll treat you as an actual kind-hearted lady then.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: So don't play dumb with me now. Why do you think what you've seen is the 'true Kjerag'?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: And who do you think is doing the oppressing here?
Melting snow atop the roof becomes water dripping into the courtyard, causing ripples in the intruder's pooling blood.
Before him, the face shrouded in light looks right back at him.
Within the great hall, the candle flames are like chained bloodthirst, raging and roiling.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: Such power... No wonder the reports on Kjerag emphasized the Black Knight's presence.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: I knew you people would try to sneak in.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You... Hmph, to tell you the truth, I can't tell which of you is which underneath those masks.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: That colleague of yours who came to Kjerag before, surely he told you this land is not one you can trample as you please?

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: Indeed. Your fame is known to us.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: We made sure to make ample preparations.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: So you intend to win through numbers.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: None of us could hope to claim victory over you. It is only a mission, nothing more.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Your clothes may mark you as elites.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: But here's something you wouldn't know without feeling some pain—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: If you wish to pass, it will only be as a corpse.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: It's rare that I have the chance to go all-out.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...I suppose I should consider you all willing to die.
She takes up a killing stance as the air is filled with the muffled cries of unsheathed weapons.
With drawn blades and cold gleams, they slowly step forward, stepping onto the puddles reflecting a muddled sky.
Upon this holy ground, a savage melee is about to begin.
The humid air warms and dries. Falling snow melts. Steam rises. Droplets splash about.
From the clash of steel against flesh come sparks of scarlet.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Hah—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Not bad! Again!

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: ...I never thought it would be like this.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: Should I not have come to Kjerag, Madame Ratatos?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: That's a question you need to answer yourself, along with your country.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: On the Kjerag side of things, I might have also considered using one as pure-hearted as you, so I can't really blame Victoria for doing it.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: ...So what exactly does the information I have mean to Victoria, and to Kjerag?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: They're just making a fuss out of you to make it look like the facts are already settled. Don't take it too seriously.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: We're hostages, nothing more.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: I feel like this is all rather absurd.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Well, that's one way to sum it up. If your camera still works, this would make some excellent material for you.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: If... I walked out that door, the rest of you would be fine, right?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: If you did, they'd point their swords at you and confiscate all your material. You yourself might even disappear without a trace, with nobody else knowing what had happened to you.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: With things having come to a head... You're the one who's meant to understand them the most, not me.

steps.name: Alberta
steps.text: So are we supposed to sit here and do nothing?

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I don't think the Victorians want to lose you, Miss Hostage.

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: Just calm down, wait, and then...

steps.name: Ratatos
steps.text: I don't care what your plan is, Enciodes, it's time to put it into action.

steps.name: Paleroche Warrior
steps.text: Reporting in!

steps.name: Paleroche Warrior
steps.text: We've built some temporary fortifications, just like you ordered, Sir Arctosz.

steps.name: Paleroche Warrior
steps.text: The enemy fleet hasn't fired yet. Instead, they're marching towards a place three clicks from us. How should we respond?

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Our explosives reserves?

steps.name: Paleroche Warrior
steps.text: We've moved over all we could. We'll be risking our lives, but at the very least, we can delay the Victorian advance for a while.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Good.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Go get the troops in formation! Meanwhile, I'll have a chat with these Victorians!
The ship stops in front of him, its dark gray armor plating reflecting the sun's light. This is one of the rare moments in Arctosz's life he is forced to look up.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: Who's your commander? Tell him to come out for a chat!

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: My commanding officer does not wish to come to blows with you, Arctosz Paleroche.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: That all depends on why you've come to Kjerag. Don't tell me you're all just lost in the woods.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: Her Grace has already made everything clear in her open letter. We must defend Victoria's interests while helping Kjerag stabilize following the Catastrophe.

steps.name: Victorian Officer
steps.text: All we ask is for the mastermind behind Kjerag's troubles, Enciodes Silverash, to receive the trial he deserves, which I believe is in line with Clan Paleroche's thinking.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The only thing I'm thinking is this: if you take even one more step forward, you'll pay the full price for it.

steps.name: Arctosz
steps.text: The only way you'll be going any further into Kjerag is over my dead body!

steps.name: Victorian Guard A
steps.text: Back already? What're the commander's orders?

steps.name: Victorian Guard B
steps.text: No changes. We keep guarding this final checkpoint. Once all their people are in, they'll definitely find Kjerag's arsenal.

steps.name: Victorian Guard A
steps.text: They've been searching for ages now, but they still haven't found anything?

steps.name: Victorian Guard B
steps.text: Yep. Even if Kjerag can't make any big moves like they said, I'm not willing to bet that that Enciodes guy doesn't have something up his sleeve.

steps.name: Victorian Guard A
steps.text: Maybe—Hmm? Another transport truck.

steps.name: Victorian Guard B
steps.text: Well, this one's all yours, buddy. I'm all tired out from checking all those beans last truck.

steps.name: Victorian Guard A
steps.text: Fine.
The guard waves down the truck slowly approaching him. It obediently comes to a halt.

steps.name: Victorian Guard A
steps.text: Sorry, mister, but as per Her Grace's orders, all vehicles passing this point are to be searched.

steps.name: Victorian Guard A
steps.text: Unload your cargo—
A thick baton smacks into his head with a 'bonk'. Before the other guard can cry out for help, a shadow appears behind him, tightening itself around his neck.

steps.name: Kjerag Warrior
steps.text: We've cleared the road again, sir, just like the plan said.
Update Sir Gnosis on the situation.
Get those supplies transported. We can't keep him waiting.
She is unsure whose blood is blurring her sight as it runs down her cheek into the corner of her mouth.
She tastes an iron tang she has not tasted in a while.
Her twin degenbrechers quiver as they fend off blades coming at her from all directions. While her enemies' wily tricks have left wounds all over her body, she has not taken a single step back.
Seven or eight of her foes lie slumped on the floor around her.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Pah...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: *cough*...

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: You are at your limit, Black Knight.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: In truth, you can still choose to lay down your arms and surrender.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: You're all mouth.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Lock up your silver tongues and come at me if you're brave enough.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: Even you must bleed.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: Would you not regret dying here, Knight?

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: ...Hmph.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Meaningless drivel when said to someone—

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Who holds their own life cheap.
Clang—!
She takes advantage of her foe's moment of complacency, sending him flying.
Most times, she could not let out a blow this strong. But now, her strength is fueled by a rage that had not burned in a very long time.
The mere sight of the scar-laden knight's furious form is enough to strike fear into the hearts of her enemies.
Some of them take half a step back.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What're you so afraid of?
The knight takes a shaky step forward, leaving behind two trails of blood upon the ground.
Her eyes shine brighter than ever, but it is the shine of bloodshot eyes. Her body is fast losing its ability to stand, yet her unwavering fervor still flows. From where, she does not know.
The candles of the hall slowly extinguish. The reflections on the floor become all the more blurry.
In the end, she staggers...
Several smoke grenades fly into the courtyard, covering everything in a cloud of fumes.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: Who's there?!

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: They aren't Court guards. Someone our intelligence didn't account for is intervening. We can't continue the mission.

steps.name: Trilby Asher
steps.text: Abort mission, retreat with the wounded.
Made it right on time...
Victoria's elite hooligans won't be sorted that easily. We need to find somewhere safe.
Wake up. This is no time for a nap.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: *cough* You're...

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Sharp?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Take it easy with the talking, you're wounded.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: Did the Doctor send you?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: SilverAsh has been in contact with the Doctor the whole time. After hearing about the Catastrophe in Kjerag, the Doctor figured you'd run into trouble.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: While we do have our hands pretty full at the moment, the Doctor did promise that if you ever found yourselves in a pinch, we wouldn't just stand back and watch.

spans.text: While we do have our hands pretty full at the moment, the Doctor
promise that if you ever found yourselves in a pinch, we wouldn't just stand back and watch.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: I've already called Rhodes Island for reinforcements, they should be here any minute now.

steps.name: Degenbrecher
steps.text: What about Enciodes?

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: No need to worry. I believe SilverAsh has managed to take the reins of this situation.

steps.name: Sharp
steps.text: Just hang in there, Degenbrecher. You're through the hardest part now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...Are we able to maintain our current output?

steps.name: Factory Foreman
steps.text: Yes sir, ammunition stocks will be as expected. But, Chairman Edelweiss...

steps.name: Factory Foreman
steps.text: I can't help but doubt things. If what we're facing is the Duke of Caster's fleet, then even if we raised our efficiency tenfold, we still wouldn't be able to compete with them.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: No need to worry. Just follow the plan.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: We'll handle the rest.

steps.name: Factory Foreman
steps.text: I've worked for Karlan Trade for eleven years now, Chairman. I know what it's brought to Kjerag.

steps.name: Factory Foreman
steps.text: I believe in the both of you.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It seems you're ready now.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: I suppose you don't need me for any further reminders, Master of Clan Silverash.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Since this is to be a negotiation, I thought I would change into something more formal.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Caster's army has laid siege to Kjerag, while her advance forces have control over several of our streets, forcing the civilians back into their homes.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Arctosz has brought his men to confront the Victorians, but they are a frail force in comparison.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The Duke's envoy came by Karlan Trade, asking me to pass you an 'invitation' to the negotiating table.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: She is waiting for you, Enciodes.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: It sounds like the situation is still within our expectations.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Look at you, admiring this lonely battleship... Does it not seem too weak as it is now?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Lately, I have found myself often thinking about a day from many years ago. The day my parents received an invitation from Clan Browntail.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: My father told me that the reason why the Browntails and the Paleroches did not support us was because they had not seen what he had seen.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: 'If someone can take a step forward, even if it is only a single step...'

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Even if it is the infamous Luca Browntail.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: They knew of the worst-case scenario, but they did not hesitate.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Now I am at the age at which they passed away. Looking back, it seems that some things haven't changed.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: But at least now I know why they did not hesitate.

spans.text: But at least now I know

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: In the wake of their passing, I followed my clan as we left Kjerag to head to Victoria.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: It was a rough start. I was learning almost out of habit as I got used to the disdainful looks of my Victorian classmates.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: The only thing that kept me going was the knowledge that one day, I would return to Kjerag.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But in the end, you went to Victoria too.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I fear I shall never forget the look on your face when I first greeted you at school.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: ...I was simply surprised by the way you greeted me, asking me if I still remembered our childhood promise like some sort of naive fool.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: 'Do you still want to make Kjerag big enough for the both of us?'

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But it was also what convinced me that everything you said, the future you envisioned, was no mere fantasy.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Thus, I hitched my rope to Karlan Trade, which leads me to today.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Today is far from enough, Gnosis.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am about to meet with the house, the most ruthless of creditors...

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...No matter if I am there to see it or not, I will give Kjerag a tomorrow.

spans.text: ...No matter if I am there to see it or not, I

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Finally, I want you to know that it's not just us supporting you. Many other people of Kjerag do too.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Karlan Trade's years of toil were not for nothing.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: If you were to ask me what I had wished to hear at this very moment...

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: You always were able to get people to tell you exactly that.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Do you have an example?

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Like when you told Degenbrecher you would treat her as nothing more than a pawn, and that when her contract expired, it was up to her if she stayed in Kjerag.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: But you already knew her answer.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps why I wish to hear such words is precisely because I am not so sure you would give me such answers.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Hah, are you afraid?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: When I declared I would make Kjerag into a grand stage big enough for us more than twenty years ago, I had signed away all rights to be afraid.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: You have experienced it for yourself. I am sure you have not forgotten.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...But at times, I too need a few words of encouragement.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: So, have Degenbrecher and I managed to provide you with them?

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: ...Without a doubt.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: I am truly glad... to have you both.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps, in the Kjerag to come, we will no longer need to make these usurious deals, or rely on the Vine-Bead Court to have faith.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: Perhaps, you two will have the better of me in—

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Enough with the self-flattery, Enciodes.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Go and see the Kjerag of your dreams for yourself.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: If you are a coward who dares not face his own dream, then so be it. Degenbrecher and I have our own things to do.

steps.name: Gnosis
steps.text: Like right now. I should go.

steps.name: Enciodes
steps.text: As you wish.
